dash.subtitle: Every page you run, in one view.

dash.draftsEmptyHint: The autopilot and the agent fill this list.

posts.title: Posts
posts.emptyHint: Clear the filter or write a new draft.

post.lintCleanHint: No check had anything to say.
post.publishConfirm: This publishes to Instagram immediately. Are you sure?
post.variantsHint: Ready to copy — Piuma publishes to Instagram only.
post.insightsEmptyHint: They sync every night at 04:30, or refresh now.
post.logEmptyHint: Every call to Instagram is recorded here.

form.caption: Caption
form.captionHint: the hook goes on the first line
form.composeSubtitle: Both paths produce a draft — nothing is published without a human approval.
form.generationDeniedHint: Your role does not allow generation.
form.generateHint: The brand plan and the real Insights numbers go into the prompt automatically.

brands.title: Brands
brands.subtitle: One brand is one page you run. The plan drives the autopilot.
brands.emptyHint: Create a brand first, then connect an Instagram account to it.

brandForm.subtitle: Everything here goes into the prompt of every draft — the autopilot's and your own.
brandForm.name: Name
brandForm.voice: Tone of voice, bans, required wording
brandForm.managementHint: Turn it on and the autopilot tops the drafts up to the plan every week — from real assets, guided by Insights. Only a human publishes, after approval.
brandForm.pillarsHint: one per line, 1–8; the autopilot rotates them
brandForm.pillarsPlaceholder:
Behind the scenes
Tip of the week
Customer stories
brandForm.keywordsHint: comma separated, up to 20; woven into the caption, not only the hashtags
brandForm.avoidHint: topics and phrasings that are off limits
brandForm.libraryHint: One asset per line: URL | description, and for video REELS URL | description | cover URL. The autopilot never invents images — no asset, no draft, and assets rotate (least recently used first).

perf.title: Performance · {brand}
perf.subtitle: The numbers come from Instagram Insights after publishing through Piuma.
perf.manualMode: This brand is on manual. Turn on “Managed by the agent” in the plan to have drafts topped up every week.
perf.planIncomplete: The plan is incomplete — edit the brand and fill in at least one content pillar.
perf.libraryEmpty: The asset library is empty — the autopilot has nothing to build drafts from.
perf.noApiKey: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is missing on the server — the autopilot cannot write.
perf.noAccountHint: Connect an account to this brand to start collecting metrics.
perf.noScope: This token was issued without instagram_business_manage_insights — reconnect the account from “Instagram accounts” to start collecting metrics.
perf.noMetricsHint: The numbers come from Instagram Insights after publishing through Piuma.

accounts.title: Instagram accounts
accounts.subtitle: Accounts are created by hand and switched to professional (Business/Creator) — here they are only connected through the official OAuth. Meta forbids automated account creation.
accounts.connect: Connect an account to a brand
accounts.connectHint: You will be sent to Instagram to approve access; the callback accepts only a signed state issued here.
accounts.disconnectConfirm: The token will be destroyed. Continue?
accounts.emptyHint: Pick a brand above and go through the Instagram OAuth.

users.title: Users
users.subtitle: Seven levels. Nobody manages an equal or a higher one.
users.name: Name
users.passwordHint: at least 12 characters, letters and digits
users.reset2faConfirm: Reset the second factor for this user?

keys.title: Agent keys
keys.subtitle: Machine access for our agents. Requests are HMAC-signed (the secret never travels), with a timestamp and a nonce against replay. The scope is narrow by construction: an agent can read and create drafts — approval, scheduling and publishing do not exist for keys.
keys.created: Key “{name}” created — the secret is shown only now
keys.createdHint: Put them on the agent's machine in a file with mode 600 (e.g. /etc/piuma/agent.env) and hand them to tools/social/piuma.mjs. Never in a repo, a chat or a log.
keys.name: Name
keys.allowedIpsHint: empty = no restriction; space or comma separated
keys.revokeConfirm: Revoke this key? The agent stops immediately.
keys.emptyHint: Create a key to let an agent talk to the panel.

audit.title: Audit
audit.subtitle: Every entry carries the hash of the previous one — a tampered old row breaks the chain and shows.
audit.chainOk: The chain is intact: {count} entries, none tampered with.
audit.chainBroken: THE CHAIN IS BROKEN at entry #{index} — an old record was altered.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Facts only, no secrets — the values live on the server. Changing them means a new deploy with a new environment.

profile.title: Profile
profile.subtitle: The second factor, the language and the password are yours alone — nobody changes them for you.
profile.enabledSince: On since {date}. Sign-in asks for a code from the app.
profile.disable2faConfirm: Are you sure? Sign-in will be password only.
profile.scanHint: Scan the code with an authenticator app (Aegis, 1Password, Google Authenticator), then enter the current code.
profile.qrAlt: QR code for the second factor
profile.disabled: Off. Strongly recommended for every role above “Viewer”.
profile.languageHint: The choice is stored in your profile and applies on every device.
profile.newPasswordHint: at least 12 characters, letters and digits
profile.endsSessions: Changing it ends every other session.

flash.notManaged: The brand is not managed or the plan is incomplete — edit it.
